audio_description:
Quistis Trepe is glimpsed through foreground bars.
The teal infirmary — desk, retro monitor, eye chart.
Quistis stands in her dark instructor uniform, hands clasped.
Close-up of Quistis, expression softening.

context.scene_title: Quistis Trepe character introduction — part of the early Disc 1 'Balamb Garden' montage that introduces the playable cast.

characters.name: Quistis Trepe
characters.recognition: Young woman with long honey-blonde hair pulled up in a clip with two long front strands, thin oval wire-rim glasses, blue eyes; wears the dark SeeD instructor uniform with orange/gold trim and a red tie. She is a SeeD instructor at Balamb Garden.

context.summary: A short character-introduction clip focusing on Quistis Trepe. She is first glimpsed partly obscured behind structural elements, then shown standing composed in her instructor uniform, ending on a calm close-up of her face. It establishes her as a poised young SeeD instructor.
